generation.forced_text:
On my morning run the weather surprised us – the clouds parted as the wind picked back-up; light hit the tinied dew droves. In moments the path I had grown accustomed, and which now seems a well-beating road between the concrete slum that surrounds my flat. Suddenly it looked as lush a garden might.
This simple realization reminded myself just why running was important – I am seeing what it takes. Not a grand moment to celebrate; yet there are the tiny wonders found, each morning on each step taken. And they add, little pieces that are, to my sense.
I find great pleasure walking or riding the bicycle
